lines.text: I have not stopped giving thanks for you since hearing of your faith and love for all the saints.
The Father may give wisdom and revelation, and enlightened hearts may know the riches of His glorious grace.
God exerted His strength in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand.
Christ is seated far above all rule, authority, power and dominion, in the present age and the one to come.
God put everything under Christ's feet and made Him head over everything for the church, which is His bride.
